name: @mattstack/settings-kit
description: Embeddable mattstack settings surface: a framework-neutral server handler over @mattstack/rt-client plus headless React hooks (callers bring their own UI).

scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && bun build src/react.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external && bun build src/shapes.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.json
